newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end up on shortage of funds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end up on shortage of funds.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates closed high on Monday amid a shortage of funds and dealers said rates were likely to open at similar levels on Tuesday despite an inflow of seven billion rupees.
"Once again the market traded at the level of 20 percent," a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
Banks discounted about 15 billion rupees with the State (central) Bank of Pakistan, the dealer said.
He said an inflow of seven billion rupees expected on Tuesday may not bring overnight rates down as the market was short of about 15 billion rupees. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
